desc:
Explore an SCP Foundation facility with your friends, study the SCPs and survive the containment breaches. When things go wrong, work together to recontain them and earn big rewards!

🎟️ Codes: VISIT100K, MEMBERS10K, MEMBERS50K, VISIT500K

🎭 Play as an SCP: become SCP-035 or SCP-049-2 and more in the next updates!
⚡ Events: containment breaches and facility blackouts
👥 Play with a friend for x1.2 cash, and join the group for a free pack and another x1.2!

⚠️ SCPs: 096, 106, 173, 035, 049, 008, 009, 294, 409, 457, 500, 6551, 066, 1025, 330, 1074 And More!

🎮 Controls (PC / Console)
Shoot, use items: Click / R2
Crouch: C / B
Reload: R / X
Interact: E / X
Night Vision, SCRAMBLE: N / D-Pad Up
Blink near SCP-173: B / L2
SCP special attack: F / Y
Close menus: X / B

💡 Ideas? Use the Feedback button in game or join the group!

Inspired by SCP: Containment Breach
🛠️ Solo developed by @yolorexthe_best
